Under Section 50(1)(c) of the Wildlife Protection Act, 1972, any trap, tool, vehicle, vessel, or weapon used for committing an offence may be seized. 

Additionally, Section 51(1) states that the seizing officer may arrest and detain the person in possession of such items without a warrant.

Finally, Section 50(2) specifies that if the owner of the seized item provides a bond for its production before a Magistrate, the item may be released to them.
